title: Rising Edge Detector
statement: Implement a rising edge detector that asserts a pulse for one cycle when the input transitions from 0 to 1 on the clock edge. The output must be synchronous and only high for a single clock cycle per rising edge. It must ignore level changes that do not occur on clock boundaries.
module_signature: module rising_edge_detector(input clk, input rst, input signal, output reg pulse);
behavior: pulse is 1 for exactly one clock cycle after signal rises from 0 to 1.
rst clears internal state synchronously and sets pulse to 0.
All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
rst is active-high and synchronous unless the problem statement explicitly says otherwise.
Use non-blocking assignments in clocked always blocks.
Outputs must never depend on uninitialized x/z state after reset.
When rst is asserted on a rising edge, registered outputs reset to their documented initial values.
constraints: Use sequential logic with registered state; do not use asynchronous edge detection macros.
hint: Store the previous input value and compare it to the current value on each clock.
